landingPage.heroDescription: The open-source CoreUI admin dashboard for React, with charts, a full component library and account pages, deployed on Hostinger at a reviewed version.
landingPage.about: CoreUI React Admin is the free, open-source admin dashboard template from the CoreUI team, built with React and Vite. It gives an internal tool, back office or customer portal a professional layout on day one. The dashboard opens with traffic charts, stat widgets and progress summaries, and a collapsible sidebar leads to example pages for every component: buttons, forms, tables, modals, notifications, icons and more. Login, register and password reset screens and error pages are included, along with a light and dark theme. You connect it to your own backend and keep the pages you need. Hostinger deploys the original project at a version we have checked, with its MIT license.
